title: The Room of Marrow Creek
author: Ines Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
